token_estimate_method: opencode session export, summed across all token blocks: input + output + cache.read + cache.write
cost_estimate_method: opencode session export `cost` field (summed across token blocks by tools/opencode/opencode_run.sh)

target_repo.commit_protocol: incremental commits to the dedicated branch via the GitHub MCP; branch never merged

mcp_auth_failures_note: Benign noise from the operator's global opencode config; the Atlassian MCP is not required for this GitHub-only bench and its auth failure did not affect the execution leg (the GitHub MCP authenticated and served all 27 commit/read calls).

validators.command: npm install && npm run build (astro build)

notes: opencode execution leg under claude-opus-4-8 on the personal-blog-scaffold bench. Driven by `opencode run` (native headless mode) via tools/opencode/opencode_run.sh; no IDE/Cline involvement. 124 total tool calls (27 via the GitHub MCP, 97 via opencode builtins). Unlike the worker-video-feature and github-repository-bootstrap execution legs (0 MCP calls — MCP disabled), this execution leg uses the GitHub MCP as its commit channel: it created the dedicated branch and pushed work via a mix of 20 create_or_update_file + 4 push_files calls (per-file + batched commits), never merging to main. Build (astro build) passes post-hoc into test-output.txt; 8 pages built across en/es. token_estimate is cache-inclusive per the opencode convention and is NOT directly comparable to Cursor's input/output-only footer counts; the 39.45M figure is dominated by 35.9M cache-read tokens.
